Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable client IP address preservation by using the automatic retrieval method. Valid values:

true: enables client IP address preservation.

false (default): disables client IP address preservation.


By default, client IP address preservation is disabled for endpoint groups of UDP or TCP listeners. You can configure this parameter based on your business requirements.
By default, client IP address preservation is enabled for endpoint groups of HTTP or HTTPS listeners. The client IP addresses are retrieved by using the X-Forwarded-For header field. You cannot disable this feature.
EnableClientIPPreservation and EnableProxyProtocol cannot be set to true at the same time.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.help_zh:
是否使用自动获取方式开启保持客户端源 IP 功能，取值：

true：开启保持客户端源 IP 功能。

false（默认值）：不开启保持客户端源IP功能。


UDP/TCP 监听对应的终端节点组默认不开启保持客户端源IP，您可根据业务需要配置。
HTTP（S）监听对应的终端节点组默认开启保持客户端源IP，通过X-Forwarded-For头字段获取。不支持关闭。
EnableClientIPPreservation与 EnableProxyProtocol不能同时为 true。
更多信息请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158080.html
fields.name: enable_client_ip_preservation

fields.help_en:
The endpoint type for a listener that uses intelligent routing. Valid values:
Domain: custom domain name
Ip: custom IP address
IpTarget: custom private IP
PublicIp: Alibaba Cloud public IP address
ECS: ECS instance
SLB: Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance
ALB: Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance
OSS: Object Storage Service (OSS) instance
ENI: Alibaba Cloud elastic network interface controller (NIC)
NLB: Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance

You can specify up to 100 endpoints in an endpoint group of a listener that uses intelligent routing.
When Type (listener routing type) is set to Standard (intelligent routing), you can configure the endpoint group and endpoint information for the listener, and this parameter is required.
If the endpoint type is set to ECS, ENI, SLB, ALB, NLB, or IpTarget, and the service associate role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service associate role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaVpcEndpoint.
If the endpoint type is set to ALB, and the service associate role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service associate role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaAlb.
If the endpoint type is set to OSS, and the service associate role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service associate role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaOss.
If the endpoint type is set to NLB, and the service associate role does not exist, the system automatically creates a service associate role named AliyunServiceRoleForGaNlb.
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178360.html
fields.help_zh:
智能路由类型监听的终端节点类型。取值：
Domain：自定义域名。
Ip：自定义IP。
IpTarget：自定义私网IP。
PublicIp：阿里云公网IP。
ECS：阿里云ECS实例。
SLB：阿里云SLB实例。
ALB：阿里云ALB实例。
OSS：阿里云OSS实例。
ENI：阿里云弹性网卡。
NLB：阿里云NLB 实例。

在智能路由类型监听的某个终端节点组中，您最多可以输入100个终端节点类型。
当Type（监听路由类型）值为Standard（智能路由类型）时，支持配置智能路由类型监听的终端节点组和终端节点信息，且该参数必填。
终端节点类型取值为ECS、ENI、SLB、ALB、NLB或IpTarget时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaVpcEndpoint的服务关联角色。
终端节点类型取值为ALB时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaAlb的服务关联角色。
终端节点类型取值为OSS时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为AliyunServiceRoleForGaOss的服务关联角色。
终端节点类型取值为NLB时，如果服务关联角色不存在，系统会自动创建一个名称为 AliyunServiceRoleForGaNlb的服务关联角色。
更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178360.html

fields.help_en:
The listener port. Valid values: 1 to 65499.

For TCP listeners: Virtual endpoint groups do not support port mappings. If a virtual endpoint group already exists under the listener, the default endpoint group cannot be configured with port mappings. If the default endpoint group is already configured with port mappings, you cannot add a virtual endpoint group.
After port mappings are configured, the following limits apply to subsequent listener modifications: You cannot modify the listener protocol, except for switching between HTTP and HTTPS.
Listener port: The modified listener port range must include all listener ports currently configured in the port mappings. For example, if the listener port range is 80-82 and port mappings are configured to endpoint ports 100-102, you cannot change the listener port range to 80-81 later
fields.help_zh:
监听端口。

取值范围：1~65499。

对于TCP监听：虚拟终端节点组不支持配置端口映射。如果监听下已存在虚拟终端节点组，则默认终端节点组无法配置端口映射。如果默认终端节点组已配置端口映射，则无法添加虚拟终端节点组。
配置端口映射后，后续监听变更时有以下限制：除HTTP和HTTPS之间的协议切换以外，不支持修改监听协议。
监听端口：您修改的监听端口范围必须包含当前所配置端口映射的全量监听端口。例如，当监听端口范围为80-82，并配置端口映射至终端节点端口100-102时，后续修改监听端口范围时，不支持修改为80-81
